source.title: My predictions for some price spikes - independent firsthand community rank-2 disenchant estimates
source.author: MrNoobyy

quote: With 100 enchanting, a maxed epic disenchanting node, maxed base node, and all rare quality gear, you can expect ~2/3 crystals to be rank 2.
notes: Unmeasured subjective forecast ≈2 of 3 rank-2 Dawn Crystals among crystals, NOT a measured probability per disenchant. Original author gives no gear input ID, ilvl, armor/weapon split, cast count, crystal quantity, zeros, profession-gear IDs or raw cohort. 'Rare quality gear' is profession equipment, not evidence input gear was rare. R2 output canonical ID 243606 crosschecked against https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/243606. Pre-2026-03-31 hotfix context; estimator reference-only.
specialization: Epic disenchanting and base node reported maxed

quote: It is useless, as disenchanting gives about 80 percent rank2
notes: Independent author in same dated Reddit discussion estimates about 80% rank-2 output without a stated source sample, gear type/item ID, actual completed casts, full per-item material hits, zeros, skill, specializations, or date of observations. Denominator implied among disenchant materials but unspecified; percentMeaning unclear, NOT measured P(hit). Contrasts MrNoobyy's approximately two-thirds estimate without established comparable player context. R2 Dawn Crystal maps to 243606 via https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/243606.
